serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: What’s going on here?
???: It’s a protest, son.
You: Yeah, I figured that much. What are you protesting?
???: These rising prices and inflation! This government is ruining our lives!
???: Can’t you see what’s going on in this country?! For the 50 years I lived here that’s the worst it has ever been!
???: Are you some rich kid that you need to ask these things?!
You: N-no, I’m not rich…
???: You should protest with us then! We are fighting for you too!
You: Well, I don’t know about that… I have stuff to do…
???: Like what?! We are fighting the good fight here, changing the world!
You: Sorry sir. Someone is waiting for me.
